steps.code:
1. the Worker:  GET …/workers/scripts/endgame-outage/settings  (its ENDGAME_SOURCE_SHA256 binding)
2. routes:      GET /zones/{zone}/workers/routes
3. the tunnel:  GET /accounts/{account}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel}/configurations  (its ingress)
4. DNS:         GET /zones/{zone}/dns_records
steps.note: What the reconciler reads before it plans, in the order it plans them: the Worker before any route names it, DNS last, so a name resolves only once the tunnel knows where to send it. Reading changes nothing.
